paragraphs.zh: R12    Wasserstoff, C1-C6-Alkylsulfonyl, Benzoyl, Phenylsulfonyl, wobei die beiden letztgenannten Gruppen gegebenenfalls durch ein oder mehrere, gleiche oder verschiedene Reste aus der Gruppe C1-C6-Alkyl, Halogen-(C1-C6)-alkyl, C1-C6-Alkoxy, Halogen-(C1-C6)-alkoxy, Halogen, Cyano oder Nitro substituiert sind;
paragraphs.en: R12    hydrogen, C1-C6-alkylsulfonyl, benzoyl, phenylsulfonyl, where the two last-named groups are optionally substituted by one or more identical or different radicals from the group consisting of C1-C6-alkyl, halogen-(C1-C6)-alkyl, C1-C6-alkoxy, halogen-(C1-C6)-alkoxy, halogen, cyano or nitro;
paragraphs.notes: Continuation of the Markush definition list for general formula (I) that runs across the preceding pages; this page carries the tail of it. The zh field holds the verbatim German, since this is a German-language WO publication and not Chinese. The 12 on R is printed as a superscript and the 1 and 6 in C1-C6 as subscripts; they are rendered inline here because the transcription is plain text. A small ink smudge sits under the 'a' of '-alkyl' in the third printed line; the letters themselves are legible and it is a scan artifact, not a character.

paragraphs.zh: L    gegebenenfalls durch ein oder zwei gleiche oder verschiedene C1-C6-Alkyl- oder C1-C6-Alkoxy-Reste substituiertes CH2;
paragraphs.en: L    CH2 optionally substituted by one or two identical or different C1-C6-alkyl or C1-C6-alkoxy radicals;
paragraphs.notes: The 2 of CH2 is printed as a subscript, as are the 1 and 6 of C1-C6. The trailing hyphen after 'C1-C6-Alkyl-' is as printed and carries the shared '-Reste' of the following alternative.

paragraphs.zh: Y und Z    unabhängig voneinander CHR7 oder C(R7)2;
paragraphs.en: Y and Z    independently of one another CHR7 or C(R7)2;
paragraphs.notes: The 7 on R is printed as a superscript in both occurrences and the closing 2 of C(R7)2 as a subscript.
Printed as its own indented definition line; the sentence continues in the next line for w.
The verb 'bedeuten' closes the whole definition list that began several pages earlier, so the English reads as the closing clause of that list rather than as a standalone sentence.

paragraphs.zh: In allen nachfolgend genannten  Formeln haben die Substituenten und Symbole, sofern nicht anders definiert, dieselbe Bedeutung wie unter Formel (I) beschrieben.
paragraphs.en: In all the formulae named below the substituents and symbols have, unless defined otherwise, the same meaning as described under formula (I).
paragraphs.notes: The double space between 'genannten' and 'Formeln' is as printed.

paragraphs.zh: Die erfindungsgemäßen Verbindungen können je nach Bedeutung der Substituenten beispielsweise nach einem oder mehreren der in den folgenden Schemata angegebenen Verfahren hergestellt werden.
paragraphs.en: Depending on the meaning of the substituents, the compounds according to the invention can be prepared, for example, by one or more of the processes given in the following schemes.

paragraphs.zh: Durch die  in Schema 1 angegebene Umsetzung einer Verbindung der Formel (II) mit einer Verbindung der Formel (III), in der R für Hydroxy, Chlor, Brom oder Cyano steht, erhält man erfindungsgemäße Verbindungen der Formel (I). Dazu wird die Verbindung der Formel (II) im Fall von R = Hydroxy in Gegenwart wasserentziehender Mittel, wie DCC, oder im Fall von R = Chlor oder Brom basenkatalysiert und in Anwesenheit einer Cyanid-Quelle, oder im Fall von R = Cyano basenkatalysiert direkt mit (III) umgesetzt. Diese Methoden sind beispielsweise in EP-A 0 369 803 und EP-B 0 283 261 beschrieben.
paragraphs.en: By the reaction given in Scheme 1 of a compound of formula (II) with a compound of formula (III), in which R stands for hydroxy, chlorine, bromine or cyano, compounds of formula (I) according to the invention are obtained. For this purpose the compound of formula (II) is reacted directly with (III), in the case of R = hydroxy in the presence of dehydrating agents such as DCC, or in the case of R = chlorine or bromine base-catalysed and in the presence of a cyanide source, or in the case of R = cyano base-catalysed. These methods are described, for example, in EP-A 0 369 803 and EP-B 0 283 261.
paragraphs.notes: The double space between 'die' and 'in Schema 1' is as printed. The German sentence attaches 'im Fall von R = Hydroxy ... in Gegenwart wasserentziehender Mittel' and the two other cases to a single verb 'umgesetzt' at the end; the English keeps that single verb, so the three conditions are listed after it. 'in der R für Hydroxy ... steht' is ambiguous as to whether R belongs to formula (III) or to formula (II); it is translated literally as attaching to (III), the formula it directly follows, and Schema 1 is on a later page and is not on this page to settle it. Note that this R is a bare R, distinct from the numbered R1 to R13 of the Markush list above. The patent numbers 'EP-A 0 369 803' and 'EP-B 0 283 261' are transcribed with the spacing as printed.
